title: Shipping and delivery
intro: How delivery areas, charges and times are meant to work.

p: The charge is a base amount for the area plus an amount per kilogram of chargeable weight. Heavy or oversize items are quote-only.
Under the Digital Commerce Operation Guidelines 2021, delivery is due within 5 days in the same city and 10 days in another city, counted from order confirmation.
We hand the order to the courier within 48 hours after an advance payment.
Cash on delivery is for small orders in serviceable areas only, with a phone code check. Maximum order value: [to be confirmed].
